New Hire Onboarding — General

All new hires complete HR paperwork (I-9/tax forms, direct deposit, emergency contacts) in
Workday before their start date.

Benefits enrollment (health, dental, vision, 401k) must be completed within 30 days of hire date
or you'll need to wait for the next open enrollment period.

IT sets up your email and Slack account on day one. Your manager schedules a 30/60/90-day
check-in.

Company swag (laptop bag, water bottle, t-shirt) is provided at the Monday new-hire orientation
session held every other week.
